name: CanonicalWireframe Package Format
core_principle: One truth. Many topologies. No duplicate truth.

ccf_format_version.meaning: Canonical Contract Format version used by Model artifacts through format.format_version.

cw_package_format_version.meaning: Version of the self-contained CanonicalWireframe package interpretation contract.

dependency_rules_version.meaning: Version of the Property/Link/logic semantic ruleset closure.

model_release_version.meaning: Version of the modeled system/reference fixture, independent of CCF/CW/DR versions.

ontology.abstraction: Every Node is an abstraction. ABS is the least opinionated predefined abstraction family.
ontology.family: A predefined abstraction contract selecting default interpretation/projection behavior.

nodetype_registry.rule: NodeType reads select default projection surfaces and never whitelist canonical Properties.

universal_node.rule: Every Node may group any number of canonical members and may own at most one physical Asset.

rules: Model/model.cw is the root manifest and is not itself a shard.
Every canonical .cw artifact below Model/ other than Model/model.cw MUST appear exactly once in shards[].
Every shards[].artifact_ref MUST resolve to exactly one regular .cw file below Model/.
Every shards[].entity_ref MUST equal the root Entity.id declared by its artifact_ref.
Duplicate entity_ref or artifact_ref entries are invalid.
A .cw file present below Model/ but absent from shards[] is not part of the canonical Model closure and makes the package invalid.

validator_scope: asset_ref resolves to a regular file below Assets/
asset is under the owner Entity identity-family directory
asset basename stem equals percent-encoded owner Entity.id
file_type_ref resolves a registered asset file type
actual extension is allowed by file_type_ref
an Entity owns at most one asset Property

filesystem_contract.path_refs: Package references are relative canonical paths only. Absolute paths, backslashes, empty segments, '.' segments and '..' segments are invalid.
filesystem_contract.case_rule: Canonical paths are case-sensitive, but the package MUST reject two paths that collide after NFC normalization plus Unicode case-folding so the closure is portable to case-insensitive filesystems.
filesystem_contract.percent_encoding: Encode the UTF-8 bytes of every character outside RFC3986 unreserved [A-Za-z0-9-._~] as percent followed by two uppercase hexadecimal digits.
filesystem_contract.symlinks: Symbolic links are not canonical package members. Canonical Format, Model and Asset paths MUST resolve to regular files/directories inside the package without following symlinks.
filesystem_contract.escape_rule: No resolved canonical path may escape its declared package root.

provenance.unlocked: A local Format closure may evolve together with the package.
provenance.locked: The complete Format closure MUST be immutably content-addressed before the model may become locked.
